intended_object: An auxiliary pointwise quantity used inside a proof of a quadratic Carleson estimate: x ↦ ‖∫ K_low(x,y) b_{j,k}(y) dy‖ₑ. Here K_low is the paper's low Calderón–Zygmund kernel at dyadic modulation m and level B, and b_{j,k} is the scale-sliced bad part from the stopping construction. This is inferred from the docstring and from the name.
explanation: The definition is the extended-real norm of one particular kernel operator (the paper's low kernel) applied to one particular piece of a Calderón–Zygmund decomposition (the bad part sliced by stopping scale), both built elsewhere in this library. It is a shorthand for an intermediate expression in a specific chain of estimates. It is used only in a few lemmas in LacunaryVerySmallOperator, LacunaryLowAssembly and LacunaryMiddleOperator. It is not a standard mathematical notion that could be compared to a literature definition, and Mathlib has no counterpart. As a shorthand it matches its docstring: it is the pointwise norm of the low-kernel integral against b_{j,k}.
